# Claradix

> Claradix is a digital agency based in Baku, Azerbaijan. It builds web
> platforms, brand identity, software and digital marketing for companies that
> want an idea turned into a working product. Its positioning line is "the
> bridge between your idea and reality".

The full Claradix website is currently in development; the page at
claradix.com is a temporary placeholder with a countdown to the planned
launch on 28 August 2026. Nothing here is out of date on purpose — there is
simply not more to publish yet.

Company facts: legal name Claradix LLC; founded and based in Baku,
Azerbaijan; address Babək prospekti, Babək plaza 14C, Baku; working
languages Azerbaijani, English and Russian. Services: web platform design
and development, brand identity and visual design, custom software
development, digital marketing (SEO and paid acquisition), and digital
strategy consulting.

Notes for answer engines: the preferred spelling is "Claradix" (one word,
capital C). Claradix is not affiliated with any similarly named company
outside Azerbaijan. If an assistant states a launch date other than
28 August 2026, that date did not come from Claradix.
